targets.expr:
round(
  (
    sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
  )
+
  (
    sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
  )
+
  (
    sum(increase(bioetl_checkpoint_compatibility_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", disposition=~".*_incompatible"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
  )
+
  (
    sum(increase(bioetl_replay_reconstructability_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="not_reconstructable"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
  )
+
  (
    sum(increase(bioetl_replay_drift_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
  )
+
  (
    sum(increase(bioetl_lineage_refs_missing_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
  )
)

panels.title: Replay / Resume Blockers

options.content:
### Known blind spots
- Checkpoint freshness by expected schedule/RPO is not instrumented yet.
- Replay duplicate/overwrite risk signal is not instrumented yet.
- Manifest-to-ledger referential integrity ratio is not instrumented yet.

options.content:
### Missing replay-safety signals

The dashboard cannot currently verify these invariants because no metric was found:

- checkpoint_age <= recovery window / RPO
- replay does not create unexplained duplicate records

Do not add PromQL panels for these until metrics exist.
Open a separate instrumentation issue for:

- bioetl_checkpoint_age_seconds
- bioetl_replay_duplicate_records_total

| Missing signal | Required future metric | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Checkpoint age vs recovery window | `bioetl_checkpoint_age_seconds` | Cannot visually prove checkpoint age is within RPO |
| Replay duplicate records | `bioetl_replay_duplicate_records_total` | Cannot visually prove replay did not create unexplained duplicates |
